title: Streaking Three Cultures onto Selective Media
constraints: one loop station at the burner
one 37 °C incubator shelf holding two plates
a supervisor signs off the readings
notes: Shelf space is the whole constraint: plates 1 and 2 take the two positions overnight and share one span, and plate 3 is held on the bench until plate 1 comes out, which is a cross-track afterStep the text states in words. The purity plate is a manual gate on the supervisor's sign-off, placed after the colony pick in the same track so it resolves from that step.
